summary: The bounded branch mappings reviewed against pinned bytes and full make check pass, but history_slice advertises/tests overlapping views while its final same-address memcpy has undefined behavior. The overlap test and its expected-value helper both use that same undefined operation, so they do not establish the asserted behavior.

findings.description: The last store maps record+0x40 to destination+0x40. The public views carry no non-alias precondition, and overlapping_views_follow_store_order passes the same array as both source and destination. That makes the final std::memcpy copy between identical overlapping ranges, contrary to memcpy's non-overlap requirement. The expected-value apply_expected helper repeats the same operation with the same aliased pointers, so its comparison is also undefined and cannot serve as an oracle. A passing optimized/sanitized run does not resolve this language-level undefined behavior or guarantee the requested ordered-copy semantics.
findings.action: Define the intended overlap contract at this adapter boundary and make both implementation and oracle valid for it; alternatively, if the pinned caller contract proves non-overlap, state that precondition and remove the unsupported overlap acceptance test. No source/test change was made in this review worktree.
evidence: history_slice.cpp:51 records source offset 0x40 and destination offset 0x40.
history_slice.cpp:87-96 performs the ordered loop and final memcpy.
test_history_slice.cpp:156-169 supplies actual.data() for both views.
The pinned consumer disassembly at 0x413F71F9..0x413F7201 loads [edx+0x40] into ECX and stores ECX to [ebx+0x40]; the machine-level load/store is defined even when the addresses match.

bounded_assessment.bounded_aggregation: The non-direct callback prefix preserves the entry DWORD increment modulo 2^32 and retains unresolved settings observations. The distinct C0!=0/accumulator+6==0 path at 0x4149E8F0 uses incoming CL as modeled; the old report's E8AB edge is a sibling C0==0 path and is not a current blocker. Signed wrapped subtraction, score operation order, and MAXSS second-operand behavior have matching code/tests. The retracted callback finding was independently assessed against the pinned branch anchors.
bounded_assessment.release_state_slice: The 0x415E01A0..0x415E01D2 route and post-helper writes match the pinned branches; the indirect dispatch at 0x415E01D9 remains a distinct unresolved boundary. The post-dispatch equality path preserves missing pointee observation as unresolved and increments the uint32 counter modulo 2^32 only when the observed field is nonzero.
bounded_assessment.reset_predecessor: The uint32 add of 0xC8, equality comparison to 0x4250309C, JNE repeat branch, and equality-only eleven-store projection match the pinned local bytes. EAX provenance, loop writes, reachability, and scheduling remain outside the model.
bounded_assessment.history_slice: The 23 ordered source/destination mappings, raw-byte preservation, explicit little-endian local DWORD serialization, and null/short adapter validation align with the bounded source evidence. Validation is an adapter constraint, not a recovered original branch. W6RC-001 blocks acceptance of the overlap behavior.

verification.coverage: Full repository check target completed: native tests, ASan/UBSan tests, and static byte/evidence verifiers. The reviewed native and sanitizer tests reported 16392 bounded-aggregation assertions, 21291 release-state assertions, 22 history-slice assertions, and reset predecessor equality/non-equality/wrap PASS.

limitations: No original binary was loaded, executed, or emulated; no full Ragebot, full GAP, original-language, ABI, or external-audit claim is made.
Runtime settings/pointer providers, helper/indirect-call clobbers, source pointer identity, and original reachability remain unresolved as documented by the bounded evidence.
The HANDOFF was used read-only; no source, tests, Makefile, shared docs, or old evidence were changed.
